description: Car accident statistics of Lebanon, 2007-2019 is a data set listed in Open Data Lebanon, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Lebanon. This dataset contains both monthly and yearly statistics of car accidents in Lebanon from 2007 to 2019. This dataset is aggregated by the number of. Coverage: Lebanon. The portal files it under the publisher Open Data Lebanon. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odl-portal.
